environment.platform: Linux x86_64 QA VM and Linux x86_64 host

diagnostics: QProcess::ExitStatus parameter metadata missing in Quickshell type information (signal-handler-parameters). Native tests verified delivery of the normal-exit signal.

testOnlyOverrides: 200 ms lifetime for the deadline scenario
absolute nonexistent interpreter in a separate missing-dependency copy

verifiedProperties: Every credential and endpoint ancestor is opened descriptor-relatively with O_DIRECTORY and O_NOFOLLOW.
Foreign-owned and non-sticky group- or other-writable ancestors are rejected before transmission.
The credential file is opened relative to its validated parent descriptor.
The endpoint is inspected relative to its validated parent and connected through that held directory identity.
SO_PEERCRED support and a matching listener UID are required before token transmission.
Held path descriptors are released after connect and on pre-connect returns.
Root-owned sticky and owner-controlled non-writable ancestors preserve successful behavior.
Existing errors, mutation submission state, data preservation, limits and no-retry behavior are unchanged.
limits: The endpoint directory identity is pinned; a same-UID process can still replace the final socket entry before connect and already has the credential's filesystem authority.
The endpoint binding requires Linux procfs and a bound AF_UNIX pathname no longer than 107 encoded bytes.
The native deadline fixture exercises TERM cleanup with a shortened lifetime; it does not simulate a kernel-unreapable process or independently exercise SIGKILL escalation.
QML admission and retention bounds exclude transient Qt read/decode allocations and total process memory.
No live Hyphae service, configuration or persistent memory was used.
